cpmplus.w6particles.menu.open.desc: Fake particles made of small planes with your image, animated by the generator (CPM has no real particles)
cpmplus.w6particles.menu.edit.desc: Opens the particle generator with the saved choices of the selected particle group and creates them again
cpmplus.w6particles.title: Particles with your image
cpmplus.w6particles.how.title: How this works
cpmplus.w6particles.how.text:
CPM has no real particles. This creates small parts with your image and animates them to look like particles.
They move with your body: they do not stay in the world and leave no trail on the ground.
It is a loop: the sequence repeats exactly (the game has no randomness).
Each particle counts as a model part (+1 for the group).
They are flat planes: seen edge-on they look thin; turning helps hide it.
Vanilla particles (endermite, portal...) cannot be changed just for you: that is a resource pack and changes them for everyone.
An animated image (several frames) only animates for you and friends; other players on the default settings see the 1st frame only. This tool uses the 1st frame.
cpmplus.w6particles.where.head: Head (above)
cpmplus.w6particles.f.name: Name
cpmplus.w6particles.f.count.desc: Each particle is one model part. Format limit: 255 animated parts per animation.
cpmplus.w6particles.f.life.desc: Length of the loop. Format limit: 255 frames and 32.7 s per animation.
cpmplus.w6particles.f.fps.desc: More frames = smoother and a bigger model file.
cpmplus.w6particles.f.distance.desc: CPM limit: up to 48 px (3 blocks) from the starting point.
cpmplus.w6particles.fade.darken: Darken (experimental: not seen in game yet)
cpmplus.w6particles.color.gradient: Fade from colour A to colour B
cpmplus.w6particles.f.glow.desc: Soft / see-through images only look right with glow on.
cpmplus.w6particles.f.seed.desc: Changes angles and delays. The game always repeats the same sequence (CPM has no randomness).
cpmplus.w6particles.f.hideFp: Hide in first person / when off
cpmplus.w6particles.f.hideFp.desc: On (recommended): the particles only exist while their animation plays. First person (your hand) plays no particle animation, so nothing flashes in front of your camera. Off: they stay visible, frozen, when the animation is not playing.
cpmplus.w6particles.previewNote: In Blockbench colour and glow do not show (particles look white); in game they are coloured and glow. After creating, open the Animate tab to see them move.
cpmplus.w6particles.budget.linkNew: Above 30 KB: a real export now needs an upload link (gist / paste). That is normal for big models.
cpmplus.w6particles.budget.link: Uses an upload link (gist / paste): download about %s KB
cpmplus.w6particles.budget.friendsQuiet: Audience: friends / safety off - the default limits do not apply to you.
cpmplus.w6particles.budget.who: Who sees it: You and friends %s · Safety off ✓ · Default (medium): %s
cpmplus.w6particles.budget.already: The model was already over the default limit before the particles.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.hand: From the hand, the particles swing and whip with the arm (walking, attacking). For particles that seem to come out of the hand, Body or Feet look steadier.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.behind: They move with you: they do not stay behind on the ground.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.darken: Darken is experimental: with glow it should look like transparency, but it was not seen in game yet. Shrink always works.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.noGlow: Without glow, soft (semi-transparent) pixels of the image turn solid or disappear.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.fpShown: They will stay visible and frozen when the animation is not playing (also in first person).
cpmplus.w6particles.note.gesture: Only one gesture plays at a time: particles during an existing emote must go 'Together with an animation'.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.withAnim: The particles follow that animation's frames, speed and interpolation.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.fps: Adjusted to %s frames per second (format limit: 255 frames per animation).
cpmplus.w6particles.note.grow: The skin texture will grow from %sx%s to %sx%s to make room for the image.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.grown: The skin texture grew from %sx%s to %sx%s to make room for the image.
cpmplus.w6particles.note.wearerSkin: This model uses the player's own skin. The image has to be painted into the skin, so the skin shown in Blockbench becomes part of the model (everyone will see it instead of your Minecraft skin).
cpmplus.w6particles.note.noLayers: The button was created without 'layer controlled': it works on servers with CPM. To make it work on any server, free skin layers in the model settings.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.noSkin: This model has no skin texture to put the image in.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.density: The skin texture has a pixel size that is not a whole number per UV unit; the image cannot be placed exactly.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.noRoom: There is no free space in the skin texture for the image, even after growing it.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.layers: The skin texture uses layers. Merge the layers first (Texture > Layers), then try again.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.noAnim: Choose the animation the particles should play with.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.noRoot: This model does not have that body part.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.noSelected: Select the part the particles should come out of.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.insideSelf: The particles cannot come out of their own group.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.tooManyParts: Too many animated parts: the animation already has %s and the particles add %s (format limit %s per animation).
cpmplus.w6particles.err.notSystem: Select a particle group made by 'Particles with your image'.
cpmplus.w6particles.err.badImage: Could not read that image. Use a small PNG (8x8 to 32x32 works best).
cpmplus.w6particles.edit.handEdited: You changed these particles by hand; creating them again replaces those changes.
cpmplus.w6particles.msg.done: %s particles in the animation "%s" (edit them with 'Edit particles...')
